objective: Complete the mission while preserving the lance and complementing weapon ranges; human orders immediately supersede autonomous choices.
knowledgeBoundary: Use only fresh information available to the friendly lance. Fixture observations and policy thresholds are proposals, not acquired MW5 state.

rules.decision: Defer when control prerequisites are unknown; preserve human orders until verified completion or explicit release.
requiredObservations: Current reciprocal AI controller/pawn binding and squad membership
Reliable manual-order origin, revision and completion/release
sourceFindings: Generic recipient resolution is not proven AI-only
Player-issued classification is not physical human origin
Menu closing is not job cancellation
assumptions: Project-only manual revision and binding generation can be reliably acquired later; currently stipulated

rules.decision: Regroup with the verified native player-squad leader when safe and appropriate.
sourceFindings: Follow initialization changes its target to GetPlayerSquadLeader during worker setup
Follow writes TravelActor and formation state
assumptions: Safe route is an input assertion, not provided by this prototype
rules.possibleNativeAction: FollowOrder -> Ally_FollowJob; first live action only after the separate proof
rules.expectedBenefit: Restore cohesion without replacing native combat.

rules.decision: Prefer a known useful firing opportunity and leave immediate firing/heat control to native AI.
requiredObservations: Current visibility and clear firing opportunity
sourceFindings: Exposed combat tactic picker considers role feasibility, weight and weapon range using native capability/range helpers
Shared combat trees contain role-specific movement and firing behavior
assumptions: Heat >=0.9 cooling threshold and envelope/threat estimates are proposed
ammoAvailable means a usable weapon opportunity, including energy weapons that do not consume ammunition
Fixture visibility is not the native remembered-visibility test
rules.possibleNativeAction: AttackOrder -> Ally_TargetAttackJob is a later candidate; no firing calls implemented

rules.decision: Use only supplied, path-verified unoccupied reposition candidates.
requiredObservations: Useful range/clear fire for engagement or relative safety for retreat
sourceFindings: Move job projects the supplied location to navigation
Projection is not proof of a complete path
Formation and movement use separate native and exposed logic
assumptions: Candidates are externally supplied fixture data; the policy does not solve navigation
Location IDs uniquely identify shared positions within a snapshot
rules.possibleNativeAction: GoToLocationOrder -> Ally_GoToLocationJob, after separate action/arrival validation
rules.expectedBenefit: Reach effective range or reduce exposure without inventing a safe route.

rules.decision: Coordinate target assignment and retain a useful target through small threat changes.
requiredObservations: Previous recommendation in the same mission/binding
sourceFindings: Existing native coordination is not replaced or simulated by this heuristic
assumptions: Prefer at most two recommendations per target when alternatives exist
rules.possibleNativeAction: Per-recipient attack intentions only; dispatch unimplemented
rules.expectedBenefit: Reduce gratuitous switching and use alternative opportunities.

rules.decision: Favor a supplied safer position for a critically damaged mech, otherwise safe regroup or native behavior.
sourceFindings: Health decorators read the living component and compare a threshold
Current health alone does not predict incoming damage or safe escape
assumptions: Health <=0.25 is a proposed research threshold
Safety is stipulated, not inferred from distance alone
rules.expectedBenefit: Preserve lance capability while avoiding unjustified escape paths.
